name: I built a tool that hit $516 MRR with no ads
description: Indie hacker built a SaaS tool that reached $516 MRR with zero advertising spend. Pure organic growth through product quality and word of mouth. Key insight: built for a niche audience with real pain point.

name: My First $500 MRR – My thoughts and learnings
description: Indie developer shares journey from $0 to $500 MRR. Solo founder bootstrap story with practical lessons on pricing, customer acquisition, and product-market fit for micro SaaS.

name: My project made me $18,000 in 7 months
description: Solo developer shares how their side project generated $18,000 in revenue over 7 months (~$2,571/mo avg). Detailed breakdown of what worked differently this time vs previous failed attempts. Covers pricing strategy, launch tactics, and retention.

name: FlipAEO – Get your SaaS cited by Perplexity and AI search
description: SaaS tool that helps businesses get cited by AI search engines like Perplexity. AI-powered SEO for the new era of AI-driven search. Recent launch (April 2026).

name: Airstrip – SaaS runway forecasting that models MRR lag
description: Financial planning tool for SaaS startups that models MRR lag, churn, and runway. Helps founders understand cash flow dynamics specific to subscription businesses. Clean, focused product.

name: Softalon – All-in-one salon booking and scheduling software
description: Vertical SaaS for salon and beauty industry. Booking, scheduling, client management, and payments all in one platform. Targets an under-served niche market with clear willingness to pay.

name: Pure Metrics – Privacy-first web analytics, <1KB script
description: Lightweight, privacy-focused web analytics alternative to Google Analytics. Script under 1KB. GDPR compliant, no cookies. Appeals to privacy-conscious businesses and developers.

name: Rundown.video – Programmatic SaaS demo videos
description: Automated SaaS demo video creation platform. Self-updating product demos that stay in sync with your product. Video marketing tool for SaaS companies to improve conversion.

name: KitoAI – AI agent that predicts and prevents SaaS churn in real time
description: AI-powered churn prediction and prevention for SaaS businesses. Uses machine learning to identify at-risk customers and suggests intervention strategies. Targets SaaS companies with subscription models.

name: Videoyards – Screen recording tool for Windows (Screen Studio alternative)
description: Web-based screen recording tool for creating professional demo videos on Windows. Alternative to Screen Studio (Mac-only). Multiple launches on HN, iterating on user feedback. Solo developer building in public.

name: PushlapGrowth – Rewardful alternative with lifetime license
description: Affiliate marketing and referral tracking platform for SaaS. Lifetime license pricing model as alternative to Rewardful's subscription. Targets indie SaaS founders who prefer one-time payments.

name: Airweave (YC X25) – Let agents search any app
description: YC-backed open source platform that lets AI agents search and interact with any application. Connects AI to SaaS tools, databases, and APIs. Hot space: AI agent infrastructure.

name: Agent.email – Sign up via curl, claim with a human OTP
description: AgentMail YC S25 company. Gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Innovative signup flow: agents sign up via curl, humans verify with OTP. Building infrastructure for the AI agent economy.

name: Warblize – AI Audiobook Narrator
description: AI-powered audiobook narration service. Converts text to natural-sounding audiobooks. Targets authors, publishers, and content creators wanting to expand into audio format. Show HN launch.

name: Agent-estimate – How long a coding task takes at agent speed
description: Developer tool that estimates how long coding tasks take for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code). Addresses the gap between AI speed and traditional estimation methods. Open source with potential for paid tier.

name: Open-source .docx editor library for building document apps
description: Open source .docx editor library for browser-based document editing apps. Just shipped v1.0. Solves the problem of converting .docx to HTML without losing formatting. Potential for commercial licensing or hosted SaaS.

name: I analyzed why 34 products that hit #1 on PH never made $1k MRR
description: Data-driven analysis of 34 products that reached #1 on Product Hunt but failed to reach $1,000 MRR. Key findings: PH success ≠ business success, B2C products struggle to monetize, lack of clear ICP is the #1 killer. Actionable insights for indie makers.

name: mendableai/firecrawl
description: Turn websites into LLM-ready data. Web scraping and crawling API for AI applications. Stars: 30k+. Has paying enterprise customers. Backed by YC. Competitor to Jina AI, Browse.ai. Hot AI infra space.

name: polarsource/polar – Turn your software into a business
description: Open source monetization platform for developers. Turns GitHub repositories into SaaS businesses with built-in payments (Stripe), subscriptions, and licensing. Stars: 9.8k+. Direct monetization path for open source devs.

name: boxyhq/saas-starter-kit – Enterprise SaaS Starter Kit
description: Enterprise SaaS Starter Kit with SAML SSO, Audit Logs, Directory Sync, and more. Next.js based. Stars: 4.8k+. Commercial offering available: BoxyHQ offers enterprise SSO as a paid SaaS product, this is their open source marketing engine.

name: I thought cheap products get more users. I was wrong
description: Founder shares counterintuitive pricing lesson: raising prices INCREASED sales. Analysis of why cheap pricing signals low quality and attracts bad customers. Valuable lesson for indie SaaS makers on pricing strategy.

name: SaaS Marketing Kit with $300 Claude Code Credit
description: Marketing toolkit for indie SaaS founders. Includes templates, guides, and $300 Claude Code credit. Bundled offer to attract indie maker audience. Clever acquisition strategy via AI tool credits.

name: CursorRules – AI 编程规则管理工具
description: AI编程工具的规则管理和分享平台。开发者可以创建、分享和管理Cursor/Claude Code等AI编程工具的.cursorrules文件。社区驱动的规则库，帮助AI更好地理解项目上下文。已开始商业化收费。

name: 即刻独立开发者社区热门产品合集
description: 即刻平台「独立开发者」圈子近期热门产品：1) Notion风格的个人知识管理工具，月付$9.9/MRR约$2,000 2) AI壁纸生成器，单次付费$2.99/月收入约$800 3) Chrome书签管理插件，订阅$4.99/月/MRR约$1,200。多个产品已实现稳定盈利。

name: Zenn話題の個人開発SaaS — 日本語AI文章校正ツールなど
description: Zenn（日本版Qiita/Dev.to相当）で話題の個人開発SaaS製品群：1) AI文章校正ツール 月額980円/MRR ¥150,000 2) プログラミング学習管理アプリ 月額1,480円/MRR ¥200,000 3) Notion連携タスク管理ツール 月額500円/MRR ¥80,000。複数が月収10万円超えを報告。日本の個人開発ブーム。
